title: The Architec's Harvest
description: The Architect's Harvest is a Fabric 1.20.1 modpack offering detailed architectural design, advanced farming, and limitless exploration. Build your dream world with high performance and enjoy a peaceful farm life.
body:
![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37d7f371aad1ff0b39cbb3f3171cee2aa125f1a9.png)
The Architect's Harvest 🌾🏰

Aesthetic design, a peaceful farm life, and limitless exploration meet in Fabric 1.20.1!

The Architect's Harvest is a comprehensive Fabric modpack featuring 85+ carefully curated mods for players who love not just surviving, but building breathtaking structures in harmony with nature. Whether you're constructing a dream mansion from a schematic or plowing your fields through four seasons to prepare chef-worthy meals, this pack has you covered.
🌟 Key Features

📐 Architectural & Design Freedom
Thanks to Litematica integration, you can import your massive projects into the game as schematics and build them with millimeter precision. Decorate the interior and exterior of your builds with thousands of new blocks, highly detailed furniture, and aesthetic fences/roofs using Handcrafted, the Macaw's series, and Chipped.

🧑‍🌾 Advanced Farming & Gastronomy
With Farmer's Delight and Croptopia, you can plant over 80 new crops and cook professional meals on kitchen counters. Thanks to Fabric Seasons, you'll feel the changing of the seasons and adjust your farming plans according to nature's cycle. Manage your fields effortlessly with the right-click quick harvest feature (RightClickHarvest).

🗺️ A Living, Breathing World
Discover magnificent landscapes with Terralith and Tectonic, which turn the world into a massive visual feast without ruining the original Minecraft feel. Delve into revamped dungeons with the YUNG's series, and embark on long journeys beyond the horizon with Traveler's Backpack and Paragliders. Travelled too far? Teleport back to your farm instantly with Waystones.

⚡ Flawless Performance
The pack is equipped with modern Minecraft's most powerful optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, and Entity Culling. Despite having over 80 mods, it offers high FPS and a smooth gaming experience. Iris is included, so you can instantly enable your favorite Shader pack (Complementary, etc.).

To fully achieve the intended "peaceful, natural, and rustic" visual aesthetic of this pack, the Stay True resource pack is highly recommended.

Requirements:

    Recommended RAM: 6 GB - 8 GB

    Version: Fabric 1.20.1

Start building your dream world with The Architect's Harvest! Have fun!
